intro: Lesson 23. Edit this 150-word paragraph to about 120 words. Cut repetition and filler; choose precise words.

passage.title: Paragraph to edit
paras: In the novel Lord of the Flies, which was written by William Golding, the author Golding uses the character of Piggy in order to basically show the importance of reason and also of order. Piggy is a character who is very, very sensible and he is always trying really hard to make the other boys listen to what he has to say about things such as rescue and the fire and rules. However, the other boys do not really listen to him at all and they actually laugh at him and make fun of him a lot, which shows that they do not value reason. At the end of the day, when Piggy is killed and the conch is smashed at the same time, this shows that reason and order have been completely and totally destroyed on the island, and this is a very important moment in the novel as a whole.

markScheme.a: In Lord of the Flies, Golding uses Piggy to show the importance of reason and order. Piggy is sensible and constantly tries to make the boys listen to his ideas about rescue, the fire and rules. However, the boys ignore and mock him, revealing that they no longer value reason. When Piggy is killed and the conch is smashed in the same moment, Golding shows that reason and order have been destroyed on the island. This is a turning point in the novel: without Piggy's voice, nothing restrains the boys' violence. (Cuts: 'basically', 'very, very', 'really', 'at the end of the day', 'completely and totally', repeated 'Golding'.)
